_comment: Canonical registry of allowed exercise `teaches` skill slugs for this course. Hand-maintained: add genuinely new reusable skill slugs here deliberately (with a human-readable `title` and `kind` in grammar|vocabulary|communicative) before using them in content.

aliases: Hand-authored. Which grammar skills (ids from grammar-index.json) each Verb Speed tense is evidence for. Verb Speed records one recycle card per tense+person ('verb:<tense>:<person>'); engine/learnerModel.js joins those cards to these skills. subjuntivo.futuro is deliberately unmapped: no skill in the curriculum teaches it.
